meta.name: oh-my-issues
meta.description: Cluster a GitHub issue backlog by root cause into a small set of plan-master issues, redirect children with a standardized comment, and bundle architectural-fix PRs that close clusters atomically. Use when an issue tracker has accumulated dozens of reports that share underlying defects, when asked to triage / consolidate / cluster / dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan series or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new incoming bug into an existing plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub issue 按根因聚类为计划，自动重定向子问题并打包修复 PR
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 issue 列表里堆满了重复报告，想按根因统一治理
copy.tagline_en: Cluster GitHub issues by root cause into plans, redirect children, and bundle fix PRs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your issue tracker is cluttered with duplicate reports and you want to consolidate by root cause

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 GitHub 仓库的 issue 列表按根因分类,为每类建一个主 issue 和设计文档,用标准评论关闭所有子 issue,最后用一个 PR 自动关闭整组 issue。
howto.when: 当 issue 仓库积累了数十个疑似同一缺陷的报告,或你要求 triage、consolidate、cluster 等整理操作,或想把新 bug 归入现有 plan 时触发。

say.text: 把这个仓库的所有 open issues 按根因聚类成 plan-master
这个新 bug 属于哪个 plan?帮我 triage 一下
把 plan-02 的子 issues 打包成一个 PR 全部关闭

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude clusters a GitHub repo's open issues by root cause, creates a plan-master issue and design doc per cluster, closes child issues with a standard redirect comment, and bundles an architectural-fix PR that closes the whole cluster atomically.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the backlog has dozens of issues sharing underlying defects, when asked to triage/consolidate/cluster/dedupe issues, when asked to build a plan or roadmap from open issues, or when routing a new bug into an existing plan.

say_en.text: Cluster all open issues in this repo by root cause into plan-masters.
say_en.note: Groups issues, creates masters and plans/ docs.

say_en.text: Which plan does this new bug belong to? Triage it.
say_en.note: Matches existing plans, appends Round N, closes child.

say_en.text: Bundle the children of plan-02 into one PR that closes them all.
say_en.note: Generates PR body with Closes #N for each child.
